MINUTES

  ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MEETING

  SEPTEMBER 19, 2017

An adjourned meeting of the City Council of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order at
4:00 p.m. in the City Manager’s Office, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by MAYOR
ZERUNYAN.

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zuckerman and
  Mayor Zerunyan

City Staff Present:  City Manager Doug Prichard

3.  PLANNING COMMISSION & GENERAL PLAN ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  INTERVIEWS

  The City Council conducted interviews for appointments to the Planning
  Commission and General Plan Advisory Committee with additional interviews
  scheduled for Tuesday, September 26, 2017. No action was taken.

4.  ADJOURNMENT

  At 6:30 p.m., MAYOR ZERUNYAN formally adjourned the City Council meeting to
  an adjourned meeting scheduled for Tuesday, September 26, 2017 beginning at
  4:00 p.m. for the purpose of conducting a study session regarding the alignment
  of the California Water Company Pipe Line Project along Palos Verdes Drive North.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Douglas R. Prichard  Douglas R. Prichard
City Manager  City Manager
